patterns.note: Full-width content sections are presented with generous vertical spacing, creating distinct visual blocks that emphasize individual projects or themes.
A sophisticated typographic hierarchy uses an elegant serif font for prominent section headings and a clean, modern sans-serif for body text and UI elements.
The site primarily uses a minimalist monochrome palette (white, light grey, black) as a backdrop, allowing full-bleed media and project visuals to introduce color and vibrancy.
As the user scrolls, new full-width content sections smoothly reveal into view, often featuring large media elements or interactive components that take center stage.
Within certain vertically scrolling sections, a horizontal image gallery allows for lateral exploration of multiple visuals related to a specific project or theme.
Each project or thematic area is presented as a self-contained, full-bleed section, often starting with a large visual or interactive element followed by minimal descriptive text.

technique_notes: The site employs a sticky header that maintains a minimal, unobtrusive presence at the top of the viewport, ensuring navigation is always accessible without distracting from content.

Content sections are designed as full-width, distinct blocks that are revealed sequentially as the user scrolls down the page, creating a curated, chapter-like progression through the site's portfolio.

A key motion technique involves embedding horizontal scrolling galleries or carousels within a vertically scrolling page, allowing users to explore multiple related images or artifacts without navigating away from the current section.

design_tokens.type_scale: Large, elegant serif headings (~3-4x body size) are paired with a clean, legible sans-serif body text and smaller, uppercase sans-serif labels, creating a balanced yet sophisticated hierarchy.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle rounding on interactive elements and card-like containers, maintaining a refined and modern aesthetic.
design_tokens.spacing: Very airy, characterized by generous padding around content blocks and significant vertical spacing between sections, which creates a sense of luxury and allows individual elements to breathe.

standout: The site's design stands out through its highly curated, almost exhibition-like presentation of projects, utilizing embedded horizontal scrolling galleries and large-scale interactive product views within a vertically scrolling layout. This creates an immersive and distinctive portfolio experience that feels more like an interactive art installation than a typical agency website.
